title: RetroPlanner: Multi-Route Expansion and Multi-Objective Reasoning for LLM-Based Retrosynthesis Planning
abstract: arXiv:2610.16391v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-step retrosynthesis planning is often considered solved once a route to purchasable starting materials is found, but such a route should also be practical in real-world chemistry. Recent LLM-based planners formulate this process as sequential decision-making over an AND-OR graph, yet typically expand a single molecule per turn and are optimized for solvability alone, leaving alternative routes uncompared across the multiple objectives that determine practicality before the search budget is committed. We introduce RetroPlanner, an LLM-based planner that jointly compares multiple routes to steer the search toward higher synthesizability, as measured by reaction plausibility, round-trip consistency, and starting-material price. translated_title: RetroPlanner：面向基于大语言模型逆合成规划的多路线扩展与多目标推理
translated_abstract: 多步逆合成规划通常在找到一条通往可购买起始原料的路线后就被认为已经解决，但这样的路线在现实化学中还应具备实用性。近期基于大语言模型（LLM）的规划器将这一过程表述为在“与或图”上的序贯决策问题，然而它们通常每轮只扩展单个分子，且仅针对可解性进行优化，导致在投入搜索预算之前，无法在决定实用性的多个目标维度上对备选路线进行比较。我们提出了RetroPlanner，一种基于大语言模型的规划器，它通过联合比较多条路线来引导搜索朝着更高的可合成性方向发展，可合成性由反应合理性、往返一致性和起始原料价格来衡量。RetroPlanner经过训练，能够基于化学证据进行推理：包括从目标分子出发的结构性进展、键的变化与反应类型、候选路线之间的分歧所在，以及它们在各项指标上的排序情况。
tldr: RetroPlanner提出了一种基于大语言模型的逆合成规划方法，通过多路线扩展与多目标推理（反应合理性、往返一致性、起始原料价格）联合比较候选路线，从而引导搜索找到更具实际可合成性的合成路线。
en_tdlr: RetroPlanner is an LLM-based retrosynthesis planner that jointly expands and compares multiple routes through multi-objective reasoning—reaction plausibility, round-trip consistency, and starting-material price—to steer the search toward more practically synthesizable routes.
